chapter: Chicago, the Marable boats and Marge's St. Louis family band
title: Tape 2 begins; the dog Breakdown and Kay Kyser
summary: Tape 2 opens in Washington in May 1975. Zutty and Marge recall their dog of seventeen years who woofed when a musician missed a note on a Kay Kyser broadcast, and Dance tells of Tuff Jordan's dog liking Louis Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

Like we was speaking about old break down, though, our dog
How many years did you have him?
Oh, about 17 years and four months or something like that.
That was a heart breaker when he went there. Then.

Oh, it was. And Marg lost some weight, and sure did grieve about that dog. We cried about that. But we were talking last night about Bring down, and he used to like write Kay Kyser's music, and he'd lay right in front of the radio, you know, we had one of those radios that was on the floor and things like that. And boy, one night Bobby Guy was playing and he missed a note, and Bring down jumped up and said 'woof.' Yes, he sure did. Because he loved Kay Kyser's music.

Well Tuff Jordan was telling me the other week, he said that here's a police dog, and he said now people don't believe this but that dog likes Louie Armstrong as much as I do. If I'm alone in the house, you know, when there's nobody in the house, he said that's when I like to play Louie Armstrong's records. And he said no matter where that dog is he comes out and lies down and listens. That's
what he likes. It is amazing.
